name: Vizcarra
description: Vizcarra was a Galactic Empire prison planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Cegul sector. The Wookiee Syychi, who went on to be enslaved by the Empire, was born there, and at one point she and the smuggler Memcha-Badawzi—who was sentenced to imprisonment on Vizcarra—both escaped from an enslaver starship traveling to the planet. Similarly, in 2 BBY the smuggler Tait Ransom also escaped from detention on the planet Omman Minor before he could be shipped off to Vizcarra.
